title: Promoting Platform Takeoff and Self-Fulfilling Expectations: Field Experimental Evidence
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. Randomized email field experiment (16,349 invitations) on disclosed installed-base and expected-user statements, analyzed with probit and linear probability models of adoption.
design_notes: Cross-sectional individual adoption outcome; randomization of disclosure statements; quadratic time controls. No unit panel and no staggered adoption.
